post.description:
Unified Chapa webhook endpoint — handles both transaction and payout events.

Chapa sends all events to this single URL. The `type` field in the payload
determines routing:
  - ``type == "Payout"``  → payout/transfer completion (referral withdrawal)
  - anything else         → subscription payment confirmation

HMAC-SHA256 signature verification is enforced on every event.
Always returns HTTP 200 on a valid signature to prevent Chapa retry storms.

post.description:
Process a delivery-status callback from GeezSMS.

Expected payload fields (all optional — the API may add more)::

    {
        "message_status": "delivered",
        "phone": "251912345678",
        "message": "Your OTP is ...",
        "api_log_id": "abc-123"
    }

Returns ``{"status": "ok"}`` on success so GeezSMS knows we accepted the
event and won't retry.
